name: word-rotator
title: Word Rotator
description: A line with one word that keeps changing, rolling out and in letter by letter while its gap springs to fit.

perf.budget: One clock drives every letter on the UI thread; the width is one spring. Words are measured once, off screen.

measurements.notes: Animates by design while words rotate; pass paused off-screen.

a11y.reducedMotion: Words crossfade in place; the gap still resizes.
a11y.screenReader: Reads the whole line once, with every word in turn, instead of announcing each change.
